title: Masala Pudding French Toast
description: A creative twist on traditional French toast, infused with the warm spices of India.
instructions: 1. In a shallow dish, whisk together pudding, garam masala, cinnamon, and vanilla extract.
2. Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
3. Dip each bread slice into the pudding mixture, coating both sides evenly.
4. Place the coated bread slices on the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes or until golden brown.
5. Flip the French toast and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
6. Serve warm with a sprinkle of orange zest and a drizzle of honey, if desired.
